areas.ag: Imperial County Air Pollution Control District
areas.t: Today, a morning inversion will inhibit mixing in the atmosphere, trapping pollutants at ground level. Furthermore, light and variable winds will allow pollutants to accumulate in the Imperial Valley. However, pollutant carryover will be low, allowing AQI levels to remain high-Good.  Tomorrow, light
